notes.title: Developer Update [Hose Update Coming Next week]
notes.notes:
Bug testing is going as expected, and smoothly. There will be a public build up on the testing branch by the end of next week. 

I am expecting to have the final public build out shortly after.

Don't forget to check out the two videos above this post if you haven't seen them yet. 



The new tanker will be included in this. I am having all of our trucks remodeled, and upgraded. 



Moving forward after this update I will be moving the game closer to simulation, and less arcade. I will adding smaller details, and making the game overall more complex with features. This build marks the end of the "building the foundation" of the game phase, and all our core systems are in place. We will be moving to ALPHA Status once this build is polished up a bit. The days are coming to an end of just being a simple firefighting game, and I want to make sure the entire fanbase has something to have fun with. 




Bakon is also working on a Manual Q as we have figured out how to do it properly. I will be upgrading all sirens, and truck handling very soon!

notes.title: Tiller Demonstration + Weekly Update
notes.notes:
First and foremost I will talk about the ETA, and Current Progress of the Firemen update part 1

- Coding wise it is about 99.9 percent complete, just need to tie up some loose ends of code. The new fire system is fully functional from start to finish, and works better than expected. It also optimized the networking by like 400 times. Which means I can expand the player count soon. 
- Canton County Phase 1 is almost completed. I expect to completely finish Station 3, and 2's area this week/coming weekend. I am aiming to release Part 1 of the update sometime during the weekend of the 29th. Obviously a loose placeholder date. so things could either speed up or take longer.
- I will be working on getting all the single levels updated with the new fire system. Wild land will also be updated with the new system so you will never have the issue of the fire not starting again. Wild land will be getting a massive update in the future. 

Overall progress is good. I took the last 3 days off from working on the game to come back refreshed to prevent burnout. Woodpecker just about finished the airport level which will be added/revealed during it's respected update. Bakon has finished the first part of the Tiller integration, only a few minor bugs to fix. He will be working on the federal Q next, then the hose. 

I'm really excited for the next few updates as it will completely refresh the game, and finally give it the replayability needed to sustain an active player base as well as give the Youtubers enough variety in the calls to make it an actual series. Just know I am going at my own pace to make sure everything gets done correctly, and smooth. I have a good game plan in my head on the direction I will be taking the game. ETA for Part 2 and 3 of the Firemen update are through out February, and Airport + Command Update will be in March. I'm going to try to release 1-2 Major updates a month.







[previewyoutube=-nm7DIuuEsE;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Weekly Update
notes.notes:
Just another daily update

Canton County should finish phase 1 of the map designing process within the next few days. Which is just the general placement of buildings, and layout of the map. Phase 2 is where I go back over, and figure out where all the emergency locations will be, start adding the interiors. Phase 3 will be polishing the map, and optimization

My vision I had of the map has been constantly evolving throughout the last week, and I feel I really nailed the rural atmosphere I was going for. Once Canton County is polished enough for a public default release, I will be able to move onto finishing the city map up. Keep in mind both of these maps will be getting more, and more emergencies added to them as time goes on. 

As for the actual firemen update it is nearing completion. I estimate I should have it out on the default branch within the next few weeks. The Testing Branch will be updated as I go.
 
Next devblog I do will be showing off the Tiller, and Federal in Action. I do not have an ETA of when that will be. We are taking our time with this update as this is going to mark a new era for ITF. I plan on moving the game to alpha status in a few months as well once all the base systems are complete. 

An early version of Canton County + City is on the testing branch now. The purpose is to allow you guys to explore the maps. Please do not report bugs in the test build. 


To Access Testing 

- Load up steam and head to your library
- Right click on Into the Flames and then select "Properties"
- Head to the Beta tab and in the drop down select "testing" (no password needed)
- This will then download the new update for you


Canton County only has one emergency on it, and the city map has none for now.

notes.title: Volunteer update rundown (Coming Very Soon)
notes.notes:
Tower truck features two man bucket, with a controllable master stream, and scene lighting

There will be 4 different firefighters to choose from now. Each one can go down to civilian clothes, with a few different outfits to choose from. There are livable houses on the map with stuff to do around each one. Every player can spawn either a normal car/truck or a command SUV. They all have lights, only the suv will have sirens. Gear will be accessible through trunk of normal cars. Halligan, Axe, and Extinguisher can be found in the trunk of the SUV. This is so you may RP home response departments. 

These systems are completely optional, and you may avoid them completely if you have no interest in them. All 4 different characters will be receiving station wear in the future as well. Fire houses will all be getting interactable doors, bay doors, and an in station alerting system. You will be able to turn off current cad notification as well. There will be pagers around the house, you may even hear the fire whistle blow from a distance. 

The houses will act like the fire stations as you will be able to teleport to them, and see how many people are staying in each house

Things to do around houses, and fire houses (More will be added in the future)

- Take out trash
- Sweep up messes
- Clean toilets
- Sleep 


There will be more expansions on the volunteering system in the future.  I will also be adding a realism mode eventually which will also optionally include more sim elements that players should fine pretty fun.

notes.title: 10 Percent off for the next week + Weekly News update
notes.notes:
The game has been selling incredibly well, and I have launched the game on GreenManGaming.com. To celebrate the launch I have put the game on sale for 10 percent off for the next week. 

Weekly update 

I am hard at work on the next major update. It will be a map expansion into a new area featuring a Baltimore city type of district. It will feature row homes, businesses, apartment complexes, and more. 

I will be adding new fire mechanics, bug fixes, and trying to polish certain mechanics up. I will be bringing in voice chat, more host options, and an actual in game tutorial level. Some quality of life features for solo players with adding a saw to the engines, and more. Stay tuned as I will keep you guys updated as the area progresses

and a few other surprises!

notes.title: July News Update!
notes.notes:
This month I am focusing on optimizing the game, reducing load times, and filling out the industrial, port, and prison areas with emergencies. Optimization is extremely important to me, and I like to add a decent amount, then spend times making sure it is performance friendly as possible. I am currently not happy with the stuttering or the extended load times people are experiencing. I am working extremely hard to reduce it by a large a large margin. 

I'm proud to announce the game has sold over 850 copies so far without advertisement since launch. The community is growing rapidly, and I'm working to keep all you guys/gals happy. I will also be fixing bugs as I go.



- Adding more details to industrial area
- Adding Port details + Emergencies
- Adding Prison Details + Emergencies
- Adding new emergencies to existing map
- Bug fixes
- Private Servers
- More Host Options
- Tuning Steering

notes.title: Status update for the week // Announcement of First Major Content update
notes.notes:
I would like to officially announce the first major content update for the game that will bring us to build 2. The update will be live by the end of the month, there is not an exact ETA but the update will bring new mechanics, trucks, and areas to the game. 


[b]New Emergency Type[/b]

engaged in special operations not currently in any other firefighting game



[b]6 New Trucks[/b]

- 2 Engines
- Tanker Replacement
- Ladder Replacement
- 2 Special operations // Rescue trucks

[b]New tools / equipment[/b]

- Chainsaw (This will be strictly for roofs, and make the rotary saw for garage doors, metal fences, and roofs)
- Fire Extinguisher (This will have a limited supply that will be used for small fires, and searching operations. It extinguishes fire a bit quicker, but only lasts for a short period of time)

Two more equipment items will be announced when the new emergency type is unveiled sometime this weekend.


[b]Quality of life changes[/b]

- Truck company will have access to gas meter now, and likewise Engine companies will have access to the fan. Rescue company will have access to both as well. 

-  carry two tools at once. With this you would be able to bring the supply line to the hydrant, and have the hydrant wrench with you, or ladder, and saw.


[b]New Playable Area / Smaller maps will be returning[/b]

- Industrial Area

- Small House fire single level

- Warehouse fire single Level


[b]Bug fixes and Misc Changes[/b]

- General bug fixing as well as will be adjusting the handling of the trucks further 

- Networking has been optimized further

notes.title: Weekly update [Dev Blog]
notes.notes:
Next actual game update will be released either this Tuesday or Wednesday. I do not have an ETA on the exact time it will be live. It will bring fixes to the CAD with calls not appearing, and plenty of other Minor fixes

The map has had changes to it as well, as the roads will now have spots of inclines, and declines. Emergencies have began to be placed in the Industrial Area. The next fire station will be coming shortly as well. 


I have revealed the new Tanker on the discord, and it will be replacing the current tanker in the game. I will be revealing the engine, and ladder in the coming week as well. There are very few issues left with fixing the multiplayer, however the few remaining issues include vehicles Desyncing, fire/smoke not appearing right away for clients, and the cad issues. The cad issues have been fixed, and will be once again included in the new patch. 

The past few days I have been fighting with my Source Control software, and finally got that fixed this morning, and progress can resume at a very steady pace.  



Once the main issues we have left are fixed, production will be zooming along. As a final note I will be looking into language translations within the next month or so as it has been a requested feature from multiple users. 


Discord can be found here : 

https://discord.gg/verj32V


Thanks everyone!
